# Hand off with the assumption

`customer_support.pb.ticket_triage.hand_off_with_the_assumption` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Write the assumption, not the conclusion, into the triage note.

The receiving agent can falsify an assumption in seconds and cannot falsify a verdict at all. Notes that record only the verdict are why misroutes persist through three owners.
